findings.description: The matcher changed from re.match to re.fullmatch, which is an unannounced behavior change: a pattern that previously matched a prefix of the exception message no longer matches.
findings.rationale: Trigger: retry_if_exception_message(match="Connection") is used on an exception whose str is "Connection refused". Before, self.match.match() succeeded and the retry happened. Now fullmatch() requires the whole string to match, so it returns False and the retry is silently skipped. The commit title only announces accepting an empty message, so this change to existing patterns is not covered by the stated intent. Impact: existing users relying on prefix or partial matching stop retrying, and failures surface without retries.
